items.title: Dermalogica AGE Bright Clearing Serum Review: 2.0% Salicylic Acid, How to Use It
items.lead: Dermalogica AGE Bright Clearing Serum: an active two-in-one serum that clears and helps prevent breakouts while reducing visible signs of skin aging.
items.hook: A full look at the Dermalogica AGE Bright Clearing Serum.
facts: Active two-in-one serum that clears and helps prevent breakouts while reducing visible signs of skin aging (30 ml)
Salicylic acid 2.0%; niacinamide is second on the ingredient list, right after water
Niacinamide with white shiitake mushroom for a brighter, more even-looking skin tone
AGE Bright Complex works with the skin's natural microbiome; resurrection plant phytoactives hydrate and smooth
Apply a thin layer, allow to dry, use under moisturizer up to twice a day as needed
Sensitive skin: build up to daily use; sensitive to salicylic acid: patch test first or avoid

scenes.caption: AGE Bright Clearing Serum
scenes.say: This is the Dermalogica AGE Bright Clearing Serum. In the next few minutes, we'll go through what it does, what's inside, and exactly how to use it.

scenes.caption: Two-in-one serum
scenes.say: It's an active two-in-one serum. It clears and helps prevent breakouts, while reducing visible signs of skin aging. So it's made for skin dealing with breakouts and early signs of aging at the same time.

scenes.caption: Salicylic acid 2.0%
scenes.say: The headline number is salicylic acid, at two point zero percent. That's the active ingredient behind the clearing side of this serum.

scenes.caption: Niacinamide
scenes.say: Niacinamide is the second ingredient on the list, straight after water.

scenes.caption: Niacinamide + white shiitake
scenes.say: Niacinamide is paired with white shiitake mushroom extract, for a brighter, more even-looking skin tone.

scenes.caption: AGE Bright Complex
scenes.say: Next is the AGE Bright Complex, which works with the skin's natural microbiome.

scenes.caption: Resurrection plant
scenes.say: And phytoactives from the resurrection plant help hydrate and smooth the skin.

scenes.caption: 30 ml bottle
scenes.say: It comes in a thirty milliliter bottle. There's also a ten milliliter mini in the Active Clearing Kit, next to a daily microfoliant and the AGE Bright spot fader.

scenes.caption: Apply a thin layer
scenes.say: Here's how to use it. After cleansing, apply a thin layer, and allow it to dry.

scenes.caption: Under moisturizer
scenes.say: Then follow with your moisturizer. You can use it up to twice a day, as needed, morning and night.

scenes.caption: Sensitive skin
scenes.say: If your skin is sensitive, build up to daily use. And if you're sensitive to salicylic acid, patch test first, or avoid it.

scenes.caption: The link is in the description
scenes.say: That's the AGE Bright Clearing Serum: two point zero percent salicylic acid, niacinamide, and a thin layer under your moisturizer. The link is in the description.

items.title: Dermalogica Clearing Defense SPF30 Review: Matte SPF for Breakout-Prone Skin, How to Use It
items.lead: Dermalogica Clearing Defense SPF30: a shine-reducing SPF moisturizer that helps protect breakout-prone skin from environmental stress, with a long-lasting matte finish.
items.hook: A full look at the Dermalogica Clearing Defense SPF30.
facts: Shine-reducing SPF moisturizer that helps protect breakout-prone skin from environmental stress (59 ml)
Broad spectrum SPF30; active filters homosalate 8%, octocrylene 8%, octisalate 5%, avobenzone 3%
Natural tapioca helps reduce shine for a long-lasting matte finish
Willow bark extract, green tea extract and vitamin C help combat the irritating effects of pollution
Apply a generous amount to cleansed face and neck, preferably 30 minutes before sun exposure; reapply as recommended
Very dry skin may feel drier; layer a hydrating lotion underneath

scenes.caption: Clearing Defense SPF30
scenes.say: This is the Dermalogica Clearing Defense SPF thirty. In the next few minutes, we'll cover what it is, what's in it, and how to wear it every day.

scenes.caption: SPF moisturizer
scenes.say: It's a shine-reducing SPF moisturizer that helps protect breakout-prone skin from environmental stress. So it's one step that moisturizes and protects.

scenes.caption: Long-lasting matte finish
scenes.say: The finish is matte, and long-lasting. That makes it a match for skin that gets shiny during the day.

scenes.caption: Broad spectrum SPF30
scenes.say: It's a broad spectrum SPF thirty. Broad spectrum sunscreen defends against UV rays.

scenes.caption: Homosalate + octocrylene
scenes.say: The active filters are homosalate at eight percent, and octocrylene at eight percent.

scenes.caption: Octisalate + avobenzone
scenes.say: Then octisalate at five percent, and avobenzone at three percent.

scenes.caption: Tapioca for shine
scenes.say: Natural tapioca helps reduce shine, which is where the matte finish comes from.

scenes.caption: Willow bark + green tea
scenes.say: Willow bark extract, green tea extract and vitamin C help combat the irritating effects of pollution.

scenes.caption: Generous amount
scenes.say: To use it, apply a generous amount to your cleansed face and neck, preferably thirty minutes before sun exposure.

scenes.caption: Reapply
scenes.say: Reapply as recommended. It comes in a fifty-nine milliliter tube.

scenes.caption: Very dry skin?
scenes.say: If your skin is very dry, this mattifying formula may feel drying. In that case, layer a hydrating lotion underneath.

scenes.caption: The link is in the description
scenes.say: That's the Clearing Defense SPF thirty: broad spectrum, matte, and made for breakout-prone skin. The link is in the description.
